title: Palmier Pro: Mac video editor where coding agents can work directly inside the same timeline as you

sections.title: Transcript
paragraphs: Palmier Pro is a Swift native Mac video editor where coding agents can work directly inside the same timeline as you connect claude codecs or cursor through its local MCP server then let the agent inspect and edit the active project. It also places image and video generation inside the timeline. It currently requires Mac OS 26 on Apple silicon and generative processing remains closed source and subscription
